description: Cancel an item you created. After the business's cancellation window, a confirmed booking is cancelled late where the business records late cancellations (it may count against the customer), and refused where it does not.

access_token.description: Capability secret returned when the item was created without an account.

idempotency_key.description: Same key + same request = same answer. Required for agents.

key.description: The person's key (sdkey1_…), if that is all you have: it is exchanged once for a pass, which comes back in identity.passes — keep the pass and send it next time instead. Never stored.

pass.description: The person's passes (sdpass1_…), space-separated, at most 8: presented to the network that issued each, so the business recognises the customer. Or send them in the Sdi-Pass header. Never stored.

name: cancel_item
title: Cancel
